lines.text: What is MangoLeaf AI? A field-ready mango health diagnostic for mango farmers.
Field-Ready Mango Health Diagnostic. MangoLeaf AI helps mango farmers to automate the classification of the mango leaf and green fruit conditions even offline.
MangoLeaf AI requires no login or registration. It works offline, runs on-device AI diagnosis, provides English and Bisaya treatment guidance, and keeps Scan History.
MangoLeaf AI supports seven classes: Anthracnose, Sooty Mold, Bacterial Canker, Mango Scab, Bacterial Black Spot, Healthy Leaf, and Healthy Fruit.
MangoLeaf AI Offline-First Tech Stack includes Next.js, React, Bun, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, TensorFlow.js, Dexie, IndexedDB, Supabase, Serwist, and MobileNetV3-Large.
Simple Walkthrough. We will show one straightforward path: scan, take a photo, view the diagnosed result, open Scan History, then view the scan detail modal.
MangoLeaf AI checks a Mango Leaf or Mango Green Fruit right on your phone, even when you are offline.
Read the Photo Tips, then use Take Photo for this simple demo. Keep one whole Mango Leaf or Mango Green Fruit in even light.
Center one whole Mango Green Fruit in the Green Box Guidance, then capture your photo.
Review your photo. After that, tap Run AI Diagnosis to start the on-device check.
Please wait a moment while the on-device model checks your photo. After that, review the result.
Review the predicted condition, Confidence Score, and treatment guidance in English.
Switch language with One tap so Mango Farmers can understand immediate treatment steps.
Your saved scans stay in Scan History for a quick return.
Open a saved scan to review the photo, result, and treatment guidance.
Switch the guidance to Bisaya when it helps.
Clear Bisaya guidance helps Mango Farmers choose next steps.
